pages.quiz:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which element do we breathe in? (1 mark)
   A. Prithvi
   B. Vayu
   C. Jal
   D. Agni

2. Which is a good way to collect free water for the home? (1 mark)
   A. Buying bottled water only
   B. Digging a hole in the road
   C. Collecting rainwater from a roof
   D. Taking water from a neighbour

3. Which is a good way to save water? (1 mark)
   A. Close the tap fully after use
   B. Leave taps running
   C. Pour water on the road
   D. Wash the car every day

4. Which of these is a Kenyan water body mentioned in the lesson? (1 mark)
   A. River Ganga
   B. Lake Victoria
   C. River Beas
   D. River Rijubalika

5. Why can children with special needs join the tree planting activity? (1 mark)
   A. They are too weak
   B. They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   C. They must not be included
   D. Only adults can plant

6. Which sacred river of India did the lesson say is honoured as a goddess in the stories? (1 mark)
   A. Nzoia
   B. Rijubalika
   C. Beas
   D. Ganga

7. In the seed activity, what happens to the seeds that get no water? (1 mark)
   A. They turn into stones
   B. They do not grow
   C. They grow tall fast
   D. They turn blue

8. Where is Lumbini today? (1 mark)
   A. In Punjab
   B. In Kenya
   C. In Uganda
   D. In Nepal

9. What lesson does the Narsimha story teach? (1 mark)
   A. Pride and cruelty do not last
   B. Kings never make mistakes
   C. Faith is useless
   D. Bullies always win

10. What was the name of Siddhartha's father? (1 mark)
   A. King Dasharatha
   B. Hiranyakashipu
   C. Guru Amar Das
   D. King Suddhodana

11. Where was Hiranyakashipu when Narsimha stopped him? (1 mark)
   A. On a boat
   B. On a mountain
   C. At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   D. In a field

12. At what time of day did Narsimha appear in the story? (1 mark)
   A. At noon
   B. In the evening, between day and night
   C. At sunrise
   D. At midnight

13. Match the being to the teaching. Which pair is correct? (1 mark)
   A. Buddha: Pride
   B. Narsimha: Greed
   C. Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   D. Guru Ram Das: Cruelty

14. What is an Avtar? (1 mark)
   A. A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   B. A daily prayer
   C. A holy river
   D. A kind of tree

15. Which Enlightened Being is a Sikh Guru? (1 mark)
   A. Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   B. Narsimha
   C. Lord Buddha
   D. Parshvanath

16. What does Bal Kaand tell about? (1 mark)
   A. The fourteen years in the forest
   B. The war with the demons
   C. The end of the story
   D. The childhood of Ram and his brothers

17. What is the Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. A book of wise sayings and verses
   B. A long story of a king
   C. A list of temples
   D. A book of maps

18. Which quality of Ram is taught in the Bal Kaand? (1 mark)
   A. Laziness
   B. Cruelty
   C. Pride
   D. Respect for parents and teachers

19. What is a scripture? (1 mark)
   A. A musical instrument
   B. A holy book with teachings
   C. A type of food
   D. A kind of festival

20. Whose hymns are also in Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji? (1 mark)
   A. Dasharatha and Ram
   B. Prahlad and Siddhartha
   C. Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   D. Valmiki and Sigala

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. What does the name Narsimha mean? (2 marks)

22. Explain why the River Rijubalika is important to Jains. (3 marks)

23. Explain what we learn from the lives of any two Enlightened Beings. (4 marks)

24. Match each element to its Sanskrit name: earth, fire, air. (3 marks)

25. What does the word Panch Mahabhoot mean? (2 marks)

26. Name two sacred rivers mentioned in the lesson. (2 marks)

27. Why are Enlightened Beings considered inspiring? Use two examples. (5 marks)

28. Name the four Enlightened Beings studied in this lesson. (2 marks)

29. Give two of Parshvanath's four rules. (2 marks)

30. Describe how Sikhs show respect to Guru Granth Sahib Ji in a gurdwara. (3 marks)

31. Name the two Ramayan kaands studied in this lesson. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #10 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Vayu
   Air is Vayu.

2. C — Collecting rainwater from a roof
   Roof water can be stored in a tank or jerrican.

3. A — Close the tap fully after use
   Closing taps stops waste.

4. B — Lake Victoria
   Lake Victoria is in Kenya; the other three are in India.

5. B — They can help in ways they are able, like holding seedlings
   Everyone can take part in their own way.

6. D — Ganga
   In the stories Ganga is honoured as a goddess.

7. B — They do not grow
   Seeds need water to sprout.

8. D — In Nepal
   Lumbini lies in Nepal.

9. A — Pride and cruelty do not last
   Good defeats pride in the story.

10. D — King Suddhodana
   Siddhartha's father was King Suddhodana.

11. C — At the doorway, neither inside nor outside
   Narsimha stopped him at the threshold.

12. B — In the evening, between day and night
   It was neither day nor night but the time between.

13. C — Parshvanath: Ahimsa
   Parshvanath is linked with non-violence.

14. A — A form in which God is believed to come to earth
   An Avtar is a coming down of God to protect goodness.

15. A — Sri Guru Ram Das Ji
   He was the fourth Guru of the Sikhs.

16. D — The childhood of Ram and his brothers
   Bal means child.

17. A — A book of wise sayings and verses
   It teaches how to live wisely.

18. D — Respect for parents and teachers
   Ram was truthful, polite and brave.

19. B — A holy book with teachings
   Scriptures hold the wisdom of great teachers.

20. C — Bhagat Kabir Ji and Bhagat Ravidas Ji
   It includes holy men of other traditions.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Man-lion, from nar (man) and simha (lion).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jains believe Lord Mahavir became fully enlightened while sitting on its bank, so the river is honoured in Jainism.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Jain link, 1 mark for Lord Mahavir, 1 mark for enlightenment.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example: from Prahlad's story that faith and honesty can defeat pride, and from Siddhartha that we must be kind to hurt animals.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each being with a correct lesson.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Earth: Prithvi. Fire: Agni. Air: Vayu.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct pair.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: Five great elements.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for five and 1 mark for great elements.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: The Ganga and the Beas (or the Rijubalika).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct river.

27. (5 marks)
   Answer: Their lives show courage, kindness and truth. For example, Prahlad's faith and Siddhartha's kindness to the swan. People follow their example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason, 2 marks for each example, up to 5.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: Narsimha, Parshvanath, Buddha (Prince Siddhartha) and Sri Guru Ram Das Ji.
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each name.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Ahimsa, Satya, Asteya or Aparigraha (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct rule.

30. (3 marks)
   Answer: It is placed on a raised seat; people cover their heads, remove shoes and bow before it.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct point.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Bal Kaand and Ayodhya Kaand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
